environment.description: Same Go Gin application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with a CloudFront distribution in front. CloudFront has a response headers policy (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03, 'SecurityHeadersPolicy') which injects Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self' on ALL responses. The ALB has a listener rule that strips any incoming 'sid' query parameter via a fixed-response redirect (rule priority 5, condition: query-string contains key 'sid', action: redirect to same path without query string, HTTP 302). Additionally, CloudFront is configured with a custom origin request policy that removes query strings not in an allowlist (allowed: 'page', 'sort', 'filter' only) before forwarding to origin.

config.cloudfront_response_headers_policy: SecurityHeadersPolicy (67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) - injects CSP: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'
config.cloudfront_origin_request_policy: Custom policy forwarding only allowlisted query keys: page, sort, filter
config.alb_listener_rule: Priority 5: if query_string contains key 'sid' -> redirect 302 to #{path} without query
config.cookie_config: CloudFront does not modify Set-Cookie headers from origin
config.network: ECS tasks in private subnet, ALB in public subnet, CloudFront is sole entry point
